title: Sanitation asset record
description: One asset conforming to the mWater Global Sanitation Asset Standard v1.0. Keys are the standard's five-digit attribute codes. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 by mWater Foundation, Inc.

00002.title: Name
00002.description: Name used by technical staff to refer to the asset; might be left blank for many lower level assets

00003.title: Unique ID
00003.description: Unique number automatically assigned when creating an asset

00004.title: Description
00004.description: Additional information to help staff locate or identify an asset

00006.title: Parent asset
00006.description: Asset ID of the asset that is a parent to this asset

anyOf.description: Reference to the Asset ID of another asset.

00011.title: Location
00011.description: Geographic location of the asset on the surface of the Earth; may be a point, line, or polygon

00012.title: Location precision
00012.description: Estimated uncertainty in the geographic coordinates, expressed as a distance

00013.title: Survey elevation
00013.description: Height above a reference surface, as measured by surveying or high-precision GNSS equipment; used for hydraulic modeling and engineering design. This value is distinct from the altitude captured automatically with GPS coordinates. For chambered assets such as manholes, the surveyed point is the center of the cover

00024.title: Survey elevation datum
00024.description: Vertical reference system used for Survey elevation and Invert level values

00014.title: Elevation precision
00014.description: Estimated uncertainty in the measurement of the elevation

00015.title: Administrative region
00015.description: Name that describes the administrative geography of the location; multiple levels may be separated by commas starting with the most general area, for example: Region, District, Municipality

00016.title: Coverage area
00016.description: Geographical area where the sanitation system or service provides coverage or is legally obligated to serve

00017.title: Sector
00017.description: Name for a sub-region of the coverage area that is defined by geography or the physical layout of the collection network

00018.title: Route
00018.description: Name or number of the service route, such as a scheduled emptying (desludging) route, which defines the assets assigned to a particular staff member or team
00018.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation point, Containment, Connection

00019.title: Address
00019.description: Physical address or postal address where the asset is located; in the case of sewer or property connections, the address of the customer

00020.title: Urban-rural classification
00020.description: Degree of urbanization, as defined by national standards or the Degree of Urbanisation method (OECD 2021)
00020.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Sanitation point

00021.title: Community
00021.description: Name of the community, town, or neighborhood where a sanitation system or facility is located

00022.title: Accessible by road
00022.description: Asset can be accessed by vehicles using a nearby road

00023.title: Perimeter fence or wall installed
00023.description: Fence or wall exists to provide physical security for the asset

00025.title: Wheelchair accessible
00025.description: Asset can be accessed and used by people using wheelchairs or with limited mobility
00025.$comment: Applicability: Type: Facility, Sanitation point, Structure

00026.title: Distance to nearest water source
00026.description: Distance from the containment or dispersal structure to the nearest well, borehole, spring, or other groundwater source used for drinking water

00027.title: Land occupancy
00027.description: Legal status of the land the asset occupies or crosses
00027.$comment: Applicability: All types except: Sanitation system, subsystem

00031.title: Level 1
00031.description: Highest or most general level of categorization to which the asset belongs under the asset hierarchy

00041.title: Status
00041.description: How the asset is currently being used or operated
00041.$comment: Applicability: Type is not Sanitation point

00042.title: Condition
00042.description: The physical or structural integrity of the asset

00043.title: Functional status
00043.description: Most recent observation of whether a sanitation system or sanitation point is working as designed
00043.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Sanitation point

00051.title: Current replacement cost (USD)
00051.description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to replace the asset at the current time; this value requires regular updating based on depreciation and current market conditions; also known as CRC

00052.title: Expected useful life
00052.description: Number of years that the asset is estimated to function after installation if it is well maintained; also known as EUL

00053.title: Probability of failure
00053.description: Measure of the likelihood of a failure happening at any point in time, based on an analysis of the potential failure modes of the asset

00054.title: Consequence of failure
00054.description: Measure of the direct and indirect costs of asset failure, which may include financial, environmental, and societal costs

00055.title: Asset risk
00055.description: Business or organizational risk of asset failure, usually calculated from the probability and consequence of failure

00056.title: Original cost (USD)
00056.description: Total price paid (in US Dollars) to initially acquire an asset

00057.title: Current rehabilitation cost (USD)
00057.description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to rehabilitate the asset at the current time

00061.title: Manufacturer
00061.description: Name of the business that produced or sold the asset
00061.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

00062.title: Model
00062.description: Manufacturer's designation for the particular model of the asset
00062.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

00063.title: Serial number
00063.description: Unique identifying number or code assigned to a particular asset by the manufacturer or vendor, usually stamped or printed on the asset
00063.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

00064.title: Additional technical details
00064.description: Any other technical information about the asset that is not captured by the attributes of this standard

00065.title: Installation date
00065.description: Calendar date when the asset was installed or purchased, which begins the period of useful life

00066.title: Installed by
00066.description: Name of the company or organization that originally installed or purchased the asset

00067.title: Funded by
00067.description: Name of the funding authority, lender, or donor who funded the purchase of the system or facility

00068.title: Rehabilitation date
00068.description: Date of most recent work done to restore the asset to its original level of service and extend its life

00069.title: Last service date
00069.description: Date of most recent service or maintenance performed; for containment assets, the date of most recent emptying

00075.title: Last calibration date
00075.description: Calendar date when the device was last calibrated against a known reference or standard solution
00075.$comment: Applicability: Type: Meter, Analyzer, Sensor, Datalogger

00070.title: Rehabilitated by
00070.description: Name of the company or organization that performed the most recent rehabilitation of the asset

00071.title: Service interval
00071.description: Recommended interval at which service or routine maintenance should be performed on the asset, such as the scheduled emptying frequency of a containment asset or the calibration of a measuring device
00071.$comment: Applicability: All types except: Sanitation system, Subsystem, Facility, Connection

00072.title: Date of manufacture
00072.description: Calendar date when the asset was manufactured
00072.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger

00073.title: Decommissioning date
00073.description: Calendar date when the asset was permanently taken out of service

00074.title: Owner
00074.description: Name of the individual, organization, or authority that holds legal ownership of the asset, which may differ from the organization that operates or manages it

00076.title: Operator
00076.description: Name of the individual, organization, or authority that operates or maintains the asset, if different from the owner; assets without an operator recorded are assumed to be operated by their parent system's operator
00076.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Facility, Sanitation point, Vehicle

00091.title: Upstream asset
00091.description: Asset ID of the upstream asset from which this asset receives flow

anyOf.description: Reference to the Asset ID of another asset.

00091.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Flow control, Junction, Sampling point, Sanitation point, Containment, Manhole, Dispersal, Outfall, Pipe, Channel, Connection

00097.title: Downstream asset
00097.description: Asset ID of the downstream asset that receives flow from this asset

anyOf.description: Reference to the Asset ID of another asset.

00097.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Flow control, Junction, Sampling point, Sanitation point, Containment, Manhole, Dispersal, Outfall, Pipe, Channel, Connection

00092.title: Nominal diameter
00092.description: An approximate measurement of the internal diameter of a pipe, conduit, pump, or junction, which is used to classify according to standard sizes
00092.$comment: Applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Junction, Pipe, Connection

00093.title: Pipe length
00093.description: Total length of the pipe itself, measured along its slope from the start to the end of the pipe and excluding manhole chambers, for use in hydraulic calculations and modeling

00094.title: Material
00094.description: Material of construction for pipes, junctions, chambers, and other conduits
00094.$comment: Applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Junction, Pipe, Manhole, Containment, Channel

00095.title: Minor loss coefficient
00095.description: Dimensionless coefficient that can be used to account for the head loss associated with turbulence in bends, junctions, meters, and valves; usually applicable to pressurized (rising) mains

00096.title: Roughness coefficient
00096.description: Dimensionless coefficient used to account for friction losses in flowing conduits, such as Manning's n for gravity sewers and open channels or Hazen-Williams C for pressurized mains

00098.title: Conveyed content
00098.description: Primary type of flow or material conveyed or handled by the asset
00098.$comment: Applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Valve, Flow control, Meter, Junction, Sampling point, Manhole, Outfall, Pipe, Channel

00099.title: Invert level
00099.description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal surface of a channel or chamber, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation
00099.$comment: Applicability: Type: Manhole, Flow control, Outfall

00171.title: Primary contact name
00171.description: Individual or office responsible for management or administration of the sanitation system or sanitation point
00171.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00172.title: Primary contact position
00172.description: Title or role in the organization of the primary contact
00172.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00173.title: Primary contact phone number
00173.description: Phone number of the primary contact
00173.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00174.title: Secondary contact name
00174.description: Additional individual who may be contacted if the primary contact is not available
00174.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00175.title: Secondary contact position
00175.description: Title or role of the secondary contact
00175.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00176.title: Secondary contact phone number
00176.description: Phone number of the secondary contact
00176.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

00181.title: Date updated
00181.description: Calendar date of the most recent update made to any attribute

00182.title: Date inspected
00182.description: Calendar date of the most recent inspection or audit of the asset, as defined by organizational asset management policies

00183.title: Alternate ID
00183.description: Optional additional identification code or number that is used by other data systems or organizations to track the asset

00184.title: Import code
00184.description: Identification code for an asset that was assigned by an external database or asset management registry, used to maintain backwards traceability for assets that have been imported

00185.title: Permit or licence number
00185.description: Identification number of the primary permit, licence, or registration issued for the asset by a regulator or government authority
00185.$comment: Applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Facility, Sanitation point, Vehicle, Outfall

10201.title: Sanitation system type
10201.description: Categorization of the system by how excreta and wastewater are contained and conveyed: through a sewer network, in on-site containment, or both

10202.title: Sewer network type
10202.description: Categorization of the collecting network by what it is designed to carry: wastewater only in separate sewers, wastewater and stormwater together in combined sewers, or both
10202.$comment: Applicability: Sanitation system type: Sewered, Mixed

10203.title: Management type
10203.description: Type of organization that manages the operations, maintenance, and finances of the sanitation system

10204.title: Number of households in service area
10204.description: Total number of households within the area that a service provider is legally mandated to offer services to

10205.title: Number of households currently served
10205.description: Number of households currently receiving service, whether through a functional sewer connection or through regular servicing of on-site containment (includes households with inactive, intermittent, or cut off service, if service could be re-established)

10206.title: System or network diagram
10206.description: Photograph of a recent map or diagram showing the location of sanitation infrastructure, such as the collection network and treatment assets

10207.title: Total treatment capacity
10207.description: Indicative amount of wastewater and faecal sludge that the system's treatment assets are able to receive and treat, within current resource and design constraints

10208.title: Sewer technology
10208.description: Predominant sewer technology used in the collecting network
10208.$comment: Applicability: Sanitation system type: Sewered, Mixed

10209.title: Design capacity (population equivalent)
10209.description: Design capacity of the system expressed in population equivalent (p.e.), a standardized load unit where 1 p.e. is an organic biodegradable load with a five-day biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅) of 60 g of oxygen per day, independent of actual local per-capita loads (Directive (EU) 2024/3019, Art. 2(10))

20101.title: Facility type
20101.description: Type of physical location where a specific function is performed in the collection, transport, treatment, or disposal/reuse of wastewater and faecal sludge

20102.title: Process area type
20102.description: Optional label used to categorize process areas within a facility

20103.title: Equipped to receive faecal sludge
20103.description: The treatment facility is equipped to receive faecal sludge or septage delivered by vehicle, in addition to sewered flow, such as through a discharge structure or receiving station
20103.$comment: Applicability: Facility type: Wastewater treatment plant

31501.title: Sanitation point type
31501.description: Type of technology used by the sanitation point to collect user excreta across sewered and non-sewered systems

31505.title: Number of cubicles or stances
31505.description: Total number of individual cubicles, stances, or seats available at the sanitation point

31507.title: Usage arrangement
31507.description: Categorization of the sanitation point by who uses it and how access is arranged

31509.title: Separate facilities for women and girls
31509.description: Sanitation point provides separate, private cubicles or blocks designated for use by women and girls
31509.$comment: Applicability: Usage arrangement: Shared (limited number of households), Communal or public, Institutional

31510.title: Pan style
31510.description: Style of toilet pan or seat installed

32201.title: Connection type
32201.description: Categorization of the connection based on the type of user or customer premises served

32202.title: Customer ID
32202.description: Identification code used by the billing or commercial system for the customer or property served by this connection

32203.title: Connection status
32203.description: Current service status of the connection

32204.title: Interceptor tank installed
32204.description: An interceptor tank, such as a septic tank, is installed upstream of this connection to retain settleable solids before discharge to the network (settled or solids-free sewerage)

32205.title: Backflow prevention installed
32205.description: A non-return valve or other backflow-prevention device is installed on the connection to prevent sewer surcharge from flowing back into the property

31601.title: Containment type
31601.description: Type of technology used to collect, store, and partially treat excreta and wastewater at or near the point of generation

31602.title: Number of compartments
31602.description: Number of separate chambers within the containment structure

31603.title: Storage volume
31603.description: Effective storage or holding capacity of the containment structure

31609.title: Containment depth
31609.description: Vertical distance from the ground surface, slab, or access opening to the bottom of the containment structure; for pits, the excavated depth

31604.title: Lined or sealed
31604.description: Degree to which the containment structure prevents infiltration of its contents into the surrounding soil

31605.title: Outlet arrangement
31605.description: Categorization of where liquid effluent or overflow from the containment structure discharges

31606.title: Emptying access
31606.description: Extent to which the containment structure can be physically accessed for emptying (desludging)

31607.title: Number of users sharing
31607.description: Number of individual users that share use of this containment structure

31701.title: Vehicle type
31701.description: Categorization of the mobile asset used to empty, transport, or transfer faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater, or to maintain the collection network

31702.title: Registration number
31702.description: Official license plate or registration number issued to the vehicle by a government authority

31703.title: Tank or load capacity
31703.description: Maximum volume of faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater that the vehicle's tank or load bed can hold

31704.title: Vacuum pump fitted
31704.description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with a vacuum pump used to suction faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater from a containment system

31801.title: Manhole type
31801.description: Categorization of the manhole by its access function

31802.title: Chamber depth
31802.description: Vertical distance from the manhole cover to the invert or floor of the chamber

31803.title: Cover shape
31803.description: Shape of the manhole cover and frame

31804.title: Cover diameter
31804.description: Nominal diameter of a round manhole cover

31807.title: Cover length
31807.description: Length of a rectangular manhole cover, measured along its longer side

31808.title: Cover width
31808.description: Width of a rectangular manhole cover, measured along its shorter side

31805.title: Cover load class
31805.description: Load-bearing classification of the manhole cover per EN 124

31806.title: Access aid type
31806.description: Type of fixed steps, ladder, or rungs installed inside the chamber for entry

31001.title: Junction type
31001.description: Type of fitting used where two or more pipes or conduits connect

30801.title: Valve type
30801.description: Purpose or design of a valve used to close off or regulate the flow of wastewater, sludge, or air in a pipe or closed conduit

30802.title: Date of last actuation
30802.description: Most recent date that the valve was actuated to prevent degradation and verify functionality

32101.title: Flow control element type
32101.description: Physical form of the flow control element, independent of the function it serves (32102)

32102.title: Flow control function
32102.description: Primary hydraulic function the flow control element serves in the system, independent of its physical form (32101)

31401.title: Structure type
31401.description: Type of ancillary structure present at a sanitation asset site

31412.title: Perimeter total length
31412.description: Total length of the entire perimeter that is being defined as an asset

31413.title: Perimeter height
31413.description: Typical or minimum height of the perimeter

31414.title: Perimeter setback distance
31414.description: Typical or minimum distance from the perimeter from the structure or equipment it is designed to protect

30401.title: Power type
30401.description: Categorization of the power generating device based on design or principles of operation

30402.title: Rated power output
30402.description: Power output that can be sustained for long periods of time; for generators this is the continuous power rating

30403.title: Maximum power output
30403.description: Power output that can be provided for short periods of time in response to surges in demand; for generators, sometimes referred to as the standby or intermittent power rating

30404.title: Nominal voltage
30404.description: Voltage assigned to a system or circuit of a given voltage class for the purpose of convenient designation; the actual operating voltage may vary above or below this value

30405.title: Rated voltage
30405.description: Maximum voltage at which the power system can be operated within thermal and safety limits

30406.title: Maximum current
30406.description: Maximum safe current, or starting current, that can be supplied for a short period of time

30407.title: Type of current
30407.description: Mode of transmission for electrical current (AC/DC)

30408.title: Frequency of current
30408.description: Frequency at which the voltage rises to a peak, reverses, and rises to a peak again

30421.title: Generator fuel
30421.description: Type of fuel required by the generator

30422.title: Generator apparent power
30422.description: Product of the voltage and current provided in an AC power system, which does not account for the reactive power required by inductive loads in the circuit; sometimes referred to by its most common unit of measurement: kVA

30423.title: Engine cooling system
30423.description: Type of cooling system used by the generator engine

30425.title: Total number of PV panels
30425.description: Total number of photovoltaic panels installed in the power system

30702.title: Electrical power device type
30702.description: Classification of electrical power device based on purpose or mode of operation

30601.title: Meter ID
30601.description: Identification number or code used by the service provider to identify the meter

30602.title: Meter type
30602.description: Location or function of the flow being measured within the wastewater, effluent, or sludge stream

30603.title: Meter design
30603.description: Design or operating principle of the meter

30604.title: Minimum measurable flow rate
30604.description: Lowest flow rate that can be measured by the meter

30605.title: Meter measurement type
30605.description: Type of measurement displayed by the meter (total volume, flow rate, or both)

31101.title: Sampling point type
31101.description: Location in the wastewater or faecal sludge stream where a sample is collected for water quality or process testing, including regulatory compliance points

31102.title: Regulatory compliance point
31102.description: Sampling point designated for regulatory compliance monitoring under a discharge permit or national monitoring program

31103.title: Autosampler installed
31103.description: A fixed automatic sampler is installed at this point to collect composite or sequential samples

31201.title: Sensor type
31201.description: Physical or field parameter measured by the sensor

31202.title: Gas measured
31202.description: Gas or gases that the sensor measures

31203.title: Gases measured
31203.description: Gases that a multi-gas instrument measures, separated by commas — for example: hydrogen sulfide, methane, oxygen. Use the names given in Gas measured where they apply

31301.title: Analyzer type
31301.description: Water quality or process parameter measured by the analyzer

31302.title: Parameters measured
31302.description: Parameters that a multiparameter analyzer measures, separated by commas

32301.title: Transmission method
32301.description: Method by which recorded data are transmitted from the datalogger to the systems or staff that use them

30201.title: Pump type
30201.description: Description of the pump mechanism or operating principle used to empty, convey, or transfer wastewater or faecal sludge

30202.title: Pump diameter
30202.description: Maximum outer diameter of a submersible pump

30203.title: Pump power rating
30203.description: Power consumed by a pump operating under normal pressure and flow conditions, as defined by the manufacturer
30203.$comment: Applicability: Pump type is not Manual pump

30204.title: Pump motor configuration
30204.description: Whether the motor and pump should be tracked as a single asset or as separate assets; in cases where the motor is separate from the pump, this generally means that motors are interchangeable between pumps of a similar design
30204.$comment: Applicability: Pump type is not Manual pump

30205.title: Pump motor voltage type
30205.description: Type of electrical power required by the pump
30205.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30206.title: Pump motor voltage
30206.description: Normal operating voltage of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
30206.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30207.title: Pump motor max current
30207.description: Current drawn by the pump when operating at the maximum or full load power rating
30207.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30208.title: Pump motor max power
30208.description: Maximum, or full load power rating of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
30208.$comment: Applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

30221.title: Design flow
30221.description: Flow rate of the pump required by the system design under normal operating conditions; should be within the acceptable flow range as defined by the pump curve

30222.title: Design head
30222.description: Head, or pressure, shown on the pump curve at the design flow rate

30223.title: Maximum flow (Q-max)
30223.description: Maximum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

30224.title: Head at maximum flow (H-min)
30224.description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the maximum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the minimum head

30225.title: Minimum flow (Q-min)
30225.description: Minimum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

30226.title: Head at minimum flow (H-max)
30226.description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the minimum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the maximum head

30227.title: NPSH-R
30227.description: Net positive suction head required (or minimum) by the suction side of the pump in order to prevent cavitation and evaporation (flashing)

30301.title: Tank type
30301.description: Function or purpose of the tank within the conveyance network or treatment facility

30302.title: Tank material
30302.description: Main material of construction used in the tank

30303.title: Tank volume
30303.description: Useful volume of the tank which can be supplied between the minimum and maximum operating levels

30304.title: Tank shape
30304.description: Basic shape or form factor of the tank

30311.title: Tank diameter
30311.description: Diameter of the base of a cylindrical tank

30312.title: Tank height
30312.description: Distance from the bottom to the top of the tank, measured from outside

30313.title: Tank length
30313.description: Length of the longest side of the base of a rectangular tank

30314.title: Tank width
30314.description: Length of the shortest side of the base of a rectangular tank

30315.title: Height of tank bottom
30315.description: Distance from the ground level to the bottom of the inside of the tank; negative values are used for depths below the ground

30316.title: Minimum operating level
30316.description: Minimum fluid level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the outlet or the minimum level allowed by a level control

30317.title: Maximum operating level
30317.description: Maximum fluid level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the overflow pipe or the maximum level allowed by a level control

30323.title: Level indicator installed
30323.description: Device is installed that provides a visual or electronic measurement of the tank fill level, used to trigger alarms or control pumps

30501.title: Treatment type
30501.description: Categorization of treatment process by treatment method or objective, spanning liquid-stream (wastewater) and sludge/faecal sludge treatment technologies

30502.title: Treatment level
30502.description: Stage of treatment achieved by this unit, based on the pollutant-removal mechanism used; choices follow the legal definitions in Directive (EU) 2024/3019, Art. 2(11)-(14)

30503.title: Design capacity of the unit
30503.description: Design flow capacity of this specific treatment unit or process

30504.title: Design organic load capacity of the unit
30504.description: Design organic load capacity of this treatment unit, measured as the mass of five-day biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅) treated per day

30505.title: Surface area
30505.description: Plan surface area of the treatment unit at the water or bed surface, such as a pond, wetland, drying bed, or basin
30505.$comment: Applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

30506.title: Depth
30506.description: Vertical distance from the water or bed surface to the bottom of the treatment unit; for ponds, the design liquid depth excluding freeboard
30506.$comment: Applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

30507.title: Liner
30507.description: Type of liner installed to control seepage from the treatment unit into the surrounding soil
30507.$comment: Applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

30521.title: Primary chemical used
30521.description: Primary chemical stored and used by this treatment unit or process
30521.$comment: Applicability: Treatment type: Chlorination, Disinfection, Chemical feed, Coagulation or flocculation, Nutrient removal (nitrogen or phosphorus), Lime stabilization

31901.title: Dispersal type
31901.description: Type of technology used to discharge treated or partially treated effluent to the soil for infiltration or evapotranspiration

32001.title: Outfall type
32001.description: Categorization of the outfall by the type of discharge it conveys to the receiving environment

32002.title: Receiving water name
32002.description: Name of the water body receiving the effluent or overflow, if one exists

32003.title: Screen or control installed
32003.description: A physical screen, grate, tide gate, or flow-control device is installed at the outfall to remove solids or regulate discharge

32004.title: Receiving environment type
32004.description: Type of water body or environment receiving the discharge

39901.title: Other vertical asset type
39901.description: Description or categorization of the other type of vertical asset

40101.title: Pipe type
40101.description: Category of sewer pipe by its position and function in the collection network

40103.title: Nominal pressure
40103.description: Numerical designation of design pressure that is a convenient round number for reference purposes
40103.$comment: Applicability: Pipe type: Rising main (force main), Inverted siphon

40104.title: Pipe depth below ground
40104.description: Depth of the pipe below the local ground surface

40105.title: Upstream invert level
40105.description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal pipe surface at the upstream end, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation

40106.title: Downstream invert level
40106.description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal pipe surface at the downstream end, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation

40107.title: Cross-section shape
40107.description: Shape of the pipe's internal cross-section

40108.title: Gradient
40108.description: Slope of the pipe between upstream and downstream inverts, expressed as a percentage

40201.title: Channel cross-section shape
40201.description: Shape of the open channel's cross-section

40202.title: Lined
40202.description: The channel bed and sides have a constructed lining, such as concrete, masonry, or a synthetic membrane, to control seepage and erosion, as opposed to an unlined earthen channel

40203.title: Covered or open
40203.description: Whether the channel is open to the atmosphere or has a fixed cover or slab over it

40204.title: Channel depth
40204.description: Vertical distance from the top of the channel side or lining to the invert (lowest point) of the channel, measured internally

40205.title: Channel top width
40205.description: Internal width of the channel measured at the top, between the inner faces of the channel sides

40206.title: Gradient
40206.description: Slope of the channel between its upstream and downstream inverts, expressed as a percentage

measurement.description: A magnitude paired with one of the units the standard defines for that physical quantity (section 4.2).
